question:
Among all the posts posted by the most influential user, identify the percentage with a score above 50.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: The higher reputation the user has the more influence; percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(stats_posts.Id where Score > 50 and MAX(Reputation))), COUNT(stats_posts.Id where MAX(Reputation));

WITH InfluentialUser AS (
    SELECT
        p.XCL_033 AS UserId
    FROM posts p
    GROUP BY p.XCL_033
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_030 > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM posts p
JOIN InfluentialUser iu ON p.XCL_033 = iu.UserId
